unspecified_scores.reason: Renaming a collection that was deleted in another tab within the ~500 ms before its event arrives gets a 404 (useCollectionManagement.ts:173-175); the input closes silently and the re-read removes the row, which is the right end state.
Every own collection write in the sidebar triggers an immediate collections re-read and then a four-GET round ~500 ms later from its own broadcast; the user sees nothing beyond extra LAN requests.

After leaving drive pages (setTags(null) at useDriveScopedReads.ts:229 without updating the tracker's shownScope) and returning to the same drive/folder, a failing tag read hits fail()'s shownScope===key early return (:82), so the Tags section stays in its null/loading state instead of empty; needs a failed read on a home LAN.
A sidebar rename that 404s (collection deleted elsewhere just before, or drive gone) closes the input with no toast and re-reads; the row disappears, so the user sees a correct but unexplained close.

An event matched in the same tick as a drive switch runs onMatch in a microtask (useWebSocketRefresh.ts:67-70) after driveRef updated, starting a round for the new drive; this needs precise timing and only causes a harmless extra read of the current drive.
Same as claude-read index 2: returning to the same drive after the no-drive state with a failing tag read leaves tags null (loading state) instead of an empty scoped list.
